info.title: LaLiga Fantasy Builder API
info.description:
LaLiga Fantasy Builder API.

Authenticated callers send an **internal JWT** minted by the auth service
(``POST /auth/token``). LaLiga-backed routes exchange that JWT for a short-lived
Fantasy bearer via auth's private credential endpoint; bearers are never
returned to clients.

LineupWrite.title: LineupWrite
LineupWrite.description:
Request body for ``PUT /teams/{teamId}/lineup``.

Slot values are ``playerTeamId`` roster identifiers, not master
``playerId`` values. Premium leagues may also send ``coach``, ``captain``,
and ``bench``.

TeamMoney.title: TeamMoney
TeamMoney.description:
Cash and investment from ``GET /teams/{teamId}/money``.

Rival teams often return empty or sparse objects; fields may be absent.
